bookkeeping_review.basis: Bookkeeping-only edits, proved mechanically: every changed Rust source is token-identical once comments and allow/expect lint attributes are removed, and every changed Cargo manifest differs only in package description and publication metadata. No executed value, seed, selection or decision changes.

method_provenance_review.basis: The sole changed input is the published provenance table. Its only changes are two provenance digests and the synthetic-control description of measured panel designs. The table supplies citations and descriptive metadata to results. Estimators, calibration lookup, reference values, assertions and thresholds are unchanged. The prior dependency binding is current on the preceding release tree.

public_api_removal_review.basis: Only unused deprecated declarations and their public re-exports were removed from the affected source files. No retained route or study reads these symbols. The original binding passed on the release baseline. The measurement, design, thresholds and executed numerical code are unchanged.

synthetic_control_calibration_review.basis: The fixture temporal_admg_route_evidence exercises temporal_admg_average_effect_graph_posterior. Its construction is distinct from the single-unit Bayesian synthetic-control panel. Only twenty- and forty-donor measurement rows changed in the shared registry.
